set.body: ADR 0028 sections 3, 4, 6, 7. After bd-01M5RAN674YW0QGQFM7RY66WXM integrates the assessor onto main: first the section 6 consumer tests (synthetic v2 fixture; graph-mode S2, real-shaped S5, absent person in a picture record, relational description, no added deixis with its licensed control, mixed record, contested class), as expected failures; then the validator change (modality-based binding, graph-owned entity equality at every site, model identity edges as proposed_* with reason, freeze declares graph run and graph SHA, SHA in claim_id, no fallback; no-graph runs only as a declared model-proposed comparison arm, decision G); then the section 7 gate on real records (part-b seconds, edition, one modality, word indices and UTF-16 offsets matching the transcript). Acceptance per decision A: the graph-mode S2 and S5 witnesses pass.
